result.headline: Control fault late in flight: pitch tracking degraded from t≈51.7 s, then throttle froze and ch[7] stepped at ≈59 s
result.explanation: Pitch loop stopped following its setpoint from t=51.7 s. Throttle and ch[2] froze at 75%/1700 us around 58.4 s, and ch[7] jumped 1101→1926 us. The recording cannot separate actuator, command-path and manoeuvre causes.

evidence.quote: SHIFT vehicle.attitude[pitch] followed its setpoint worse for good from t=51.718 s: typical |error| 1.079 before, 12.649 after deg (17.6x its variation before)
evidence.shows: Earliest sustained control degradation is in the pitch loop at 51.7 s, before the freezes.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT propulsion.throttle was varying, then held 75 from t=58.553 s to the end of the recording (8.44 s, 23 samples)
evidence.shows: Throttle command froze with no mode event; the recording does not show who or what commanded it.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[2]] was varying, then held 1700 from t=58.382 s to the end of the recording (8.821 s, 27 samples)
evidence.shows: The throttle output channel froze at 1700 us, slightly before the throttle value froze. It serves the throttle loop (line 32).

evidence.quote: CHANGE actuator.output[ch[7]] at t=59.665 s: 1101 -> 1926 us (step 825, 1000x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: The ch[7] output, which serves the pitch loop (line 33), sat constant for 59.7 s, then stepped by 825 us.

evidence.quote: TRACKING vehicle.attitude[pitch] diverged from its setpoint from t=54.906 to 65.967 s (peak |error| 23.926 deg)
evidence.shows: The pitch loop diverged badly through to the end of the recording.

checked.check: Sequence of departures from baseline, 38-62 s
checked.result: Roll, yaw and pitch setpoints left baseline first (38.0-38.2 s). ch[7] left baseline last (59.997 s). No events in the window.
Pitch tracking error ratio 3.47 (0.736→2.551 deg). Roll and yaw tracking unchanged (ratios 1.11 and 1.39). Throttle and ch[2] had not frozen yet.
checked.about: Pitch-loop fault, with the setpoint changing at the same time

checked.result: Throttle and ch[2] frozen (spread 0 after). Pitch error 6.551→16.974 deg. ch[7] shifted by 74.9x. Roll and yaw tracking stayed normal.
Only two start-up warnings at t=0.144 s (low voltage, sensor helth). No mode or failsafe event. No earlier cases.
checked.about: Whether the start-up warnings or failsafes explain the freeze

effects.quote: SHIFT vehicle.altitude[relative] changed level for good at t=60.759 s: median 49.408 before, 34.833 after m (18.2x its variation before)
effects.why: Altitude loss follows the pitch divergence and the throttle freeze.

effects.quote: ANOMALY a9 t=59.044 s: actuator.output[ch[1]] changed level for good (1477 -> 1198 us)
effects.why: ch[1] follows the pitch setpoint (line 31). Its shift is a response to the pitch error.

next_action.why: Settles what ch[7] drives and whether the 58.4 s freeze came from the controller, a mode/failsafe change or the link, which this recording cannot show.
how: Read the output mixer config: which surface or motor ch[7] drives, and its trim value (1101 us?)
Read the full flight log for mode changes, RC-loss or failsafe, and throttle-hold logic near t=50-60 s

outcomes.label: ch[7] is a pitch surface, stuck low all flight
outcomes.means: The pitch actuator or its linkage is the main suspect. The late step is the surface freeing up or being commanded by a failsafe.
outcomes.then: Request bench actuator and linkage inspection

outcomes.label: Mode or failsafe switch at 58.4 s
outcomes.means: Throttle freeze is the designed failsafe response. The pitch divergence started earlier and is a separate fault.

outcomes.label: ch[7] is unrelated to pitch
outcomes.means: The pitch-actuator hypothesis weakens; sensor or manoeuvre causes stay open.
outcomes.then: Compare IMU pitch with the pitch setpoint step at 53.9 s

hypotheses.claim: The ch[7] pitch output or its surface is stuck or faulty, and the pitch loop loses authority.
hypotheses.because: ch[7] was constant 59.7 s despite serving the pitch loop, then stepped 825 us. Pitch error rose at 51.7 s, before that step. Not proven.

hypotheses.claim: Throttle and ch[2] froze at 75%/1700 us through a controller or link fault, or a failsafe hold.
hypotheses.because: Held with spread 0 after 58.4 s with no event. Pitch error began earlier, so it is probably not the first fault.

hypotheses.claim: Pitch estimate or IMU error makes the pitch loop appear to diverge.
hypotheses.because: Roll and yaw tracking stayed normal, which weakens a shared IMU fault. Pitch alone is not excluded.

hypotheses.claim: Aggressive pitch setpoint step at 53.9 s and wind or load exceed authority.
hypotheses.because: Pitch setpoint shifted 1.47→17.44 deg at 53.9 s, but error was already growing from 51.7 s.
